🌅 Morning Routine
6:40 AM · 25 min
1
Cleanse — Cetaphil / Himalaya Neem. Cool water.Draws out oil without stripping
2
Toner — Rose water or Minimalist AHA. Pat gently.
3
Vit C Serum — Minimalist 10%. 2–3 drops.Glow + tan fade
4
Moisturiser — Neutrogena Ultra Sheer SPF30.
5
Sunscreen — Bioré UV SPF50. Arms, neck, legs too.
🌙 Evening Routine
10:15 PM · 15 min
1
Double Cleanse — Micellar water then face wash.Removes SPF + pollution
2
Exfoliate Mon + Thu — Minimalist AHA 25% + BHA 2%.
3
Niacinamide 10% — Minimalist. Daily.Pores + dark spots + oil
4
Retinol Tue/Fri/Sun — Minimalist 0.2%. After moisturiser.
5
Night Cream — CeraVe Moisturising Cream.
6
Eye Cream — Mamaearth Under Eye. Ring finger only.
🖤 Charcoal Routine
Face
1
Charcoal Cleanser — Daily AM & PMPinch activated charcoal + Cetaphil. 60 sec. Toner + moisturiser after.
2
Face Mask — Tue / Thu / Sat½ tsp charcoal + 1 tsp bentonite clay + rose water. 10–15 min. Follow with CeraVe.
3
Spot Treatment — Active breakouts onlyCharcoal + tea tree oil + aloe. Cotton swab only.
Body + Teeth
4
Body Scrub — Mon & Thu shower1 tsp charcoal + 3 tbsp sugar + 2 tbsp coconut oil. Elbows, knees, tan areas.
5
Detox Bath — Once/week OFF day1–2 tbsp charcoal + 1 cup Epsom salt. Soak 20 min. Moisturise after.
6
Charcoal Toothpaste — 2–3×/weekColgate Vedshakti. Brush 2 min. Follow with fluoride.
